concepts.name: 01-vortex
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE captivating ORIGINAL abstract three-dimensional brand glyph, NOT a literal icon. The intended brand is an independent AI exam trainer whose website features beautiful mathematical 3D sculptures inspired by Yandex AI Studio's abstract creative backgrounds: soft lavender/citron gradients flowing over curved petal-like surfaces, layered topological folds, sophisticated quiet fluid motion, petrol-teal accents. Create a new ownable sculptural FORM in that visual language, never an actual Yandex/OpenAI mark. Style: polished editorial CGI, mathematically smooth surfaces, satin light, subtle iridescent lavender-to-citron transitions with dark purple or petrol-teal recessed planes for contrast; NO grain, rubber-toy texture, plastic shine or metallic chrome. Strong, unforgettable compact silhouette that stays recognisable as a favicon at 16 and 32px: FEW large structural masses, broad openings and grooves, no microdetail. The user wants a beautiful abstract object that also behaves as a glyph, not a metaphor illustration. Fully isolated on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, clean alpha; square canvas, approximately 82% symbol occupancy with clear margins, entire mark visible. No floor, cast shadows outside the object, backdrop, tiles, frame, watermark, text or label. ABSOLUTELY NO letters, initials, numbers, keys/keyholes, sticks/rods, checkmarks, arrows, locks, brains, circuit clipart, books, caps, sparkles or literal recognizable props. No thin ribbons, interwoven knots, generic infinity loop, detached parts, supporting ornaments or extra objects. Prioritise original sculptural beauty and a bold simple silhouette. FORM 1: A compact five-lobed vortex rosette made from exactly FIVE broad curved sculptural petal-masses fused into one flowing volume. Each lobe curls inward gently, creating a deep dark-purple central swirl of generous width; a softly scalloped almost round outer silhouette. Think mathematical seashell meeting a folded radial sculpture, not a literal flower, not a propeller or gear. Petals are thick beautiful curved surfaces, never strips; they have lavender faces with luminous citron gradients near the inner folds and just one petrol-teal recessed accent. Near frontal orientation with gentle dimensional tilt. Iconically simple 5-lobed contour; no more than five broad folds, no tiny repeated blades. One exceptionally designed art object.
